 Appearance :

 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Surendra Kumar, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar
 Oral Order

3 08-11-2023 Heard Mr. Sunil Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner who happens to be husband of the informant (O.P. No.2) is apprehending his arrest in connection with Brahampura P.S. Case No. 269 of 2022 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323 and 379/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3.
The marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with the informant (O.P. No.2) in the year 2020.

However, soon after the marriage, she was allegedly subjected to demand of dowry and on non-fulfillment of the same, she was tortured in various Patna High Court CR. MISC. No. 55987 of 2023(3) dt.08-11-2023 ways and finally ousted from her matrimonial home resulting into lodging of the present FIR.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that irrespective of all the odds and the fact that the O.P. No.2 is a quarrelsome lady, still the petitioner is ready to keep the O.P. No.2 as his wife with full Rahul Kumar @ Rahul Kumar Mahto vs The State Of Bihar on 8 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19164941/
1 honour and dignity, if she is ready to cooperate.

entities.text: Patna High Court Mediation & Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the informant while refuting the contention of the petitioner with regard to the nature of the O.P. No.2, submits that in fact the case is otherwise and it is the petitioner, who has always been indulged in torturing the O.P. No.2.
However, if there is any chance of settlement, the informant is also ready to settle the matter.
6. Considering the submissions made on behalf of the parties, let the matter be referred to the Patna High Court Mediation & Conciliation Centre.

entities.text: Patna High Court Mediation & Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The parties are directed to appear before the Mediation Centre on 30.11.2023 along with relevant documents.

7. Re-notify this case on 22.01.2024 along with the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No. 55987 of 2023(3) dt.08-11-2023 report of the Mediation and Conciliation Centre.
8.
In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Brahampura P.S. Case No. 269 of 2022, till further order.

(Harish Kumar, J) rohit/-
